graphs: Repair three injected 900 m terrain spikes

formulas.ascii: Join 4-neighbours with abs(dh)<=jump, label components and choose the largest (ties lowest label) as main. For each ordered seam, k=round(dh*f32(1/step)); vote iff 0<abs(k)<=127 and abs(dh-step*k)<tolerance. Reconstruct candidate k by strict majority bits, recount agreeing seams. Shift a converged nonempty non-main component only if size*100<=validCount*maximumComponentPercent, seams>0, candidate exists and agreeCount*100>=seams*agreementPercent; replace h by h-step*k, otherwise keep h. Invalid cells stay NaN/validity 0. Nonconvergence gives valid input cells +Infinity, validity 0, labels 0xffffffff and convergence 0.
